name: Triage real estate inbox leads and deals with Gmail, Gemini and Sheets

parameters.content:
## Triage real estate inbox leads and deals with Gmail, Gemini and Sheets

### How it works
1. Checks your agency Gmail inbox every minute and skips emails already in the Email Log.
2. Reloads the Leads, Properties, Sale Deals and Rental Deals sheets for each email, so new IDs never clash.
3. Gemini sorts the email into lead, contract update, rental listing or other, and extracts the details.
4. A Code node matches the person (email or phone), the property and the deal, and decides which cells to write.
5. Leads and listings get a reply draft in the same Gmail thread. Deal updates send your team a summary.
6. Every email is logged. Low confidence or unclear matches are marked Needs Review and nothing is changed.

### Setup steps
- [ ] Make a copy of the 5 template sheets: [Leads](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1kp3E6wpWTDN64Im-Bx40HtLF1M9cXgcr_LFNa9UnSi8/copy), [Properties](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1KvKPOIGhZD76_JN3QN988GvDa6X9-JsLBEIww_li3ks/copy), [Sale Deals](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/19Nkqicy_tyP9q-NgUXGVPaXHo6zH2WXWT7W1_e48SBY/copy), [Rental Deals](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1DLc4mkMe26cpG7HYJGE8JWlxUm_z7ONOnEVQ7H6Oys4/copy), [Email Log](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1oXuZ47iEQoLg9IAs0U3tq-EY_lvCMWDZ_qfGo1Zz6sk/copy)
- [ ] In **Config**, paste the 5 sheet URLs and set ownEmails, teamEmail, agencyName, signature and timezone
- [ ] Connect a Gmail OAuth2 credential to Gmail Trigger, Create Gmail Draft and Notify Team
- [ ] Connect a Google Sheets OAuth2 credential to all Google Sheets nodes
- [ ] Add a Google Gemini API key (free from Google AI Studio) to both Gemini model nodes
- [ ] Send a test email from another address, run the workflow, check the sheets and drafts, then activate

### Customization
- Raise or lower minConfidence in **Config** to send more or fewer emails to Needs Review.
- Edit the prompt in **Build AI Context** to add email types or extra fields.
- Replies are only saved as drafts. Keep the sheet tab names and column headers unchanged.

## Intake and dedupe

Checks Gmail every minute, skips emails that are already logged and handles one email at a time.

## Load the CRM sheets

Reads the 4 CRM sheets fresh for every email, so new IDs never clash.

## Understand the email

Gemini classifies the email and extracts the details. Plan Actions matches the lead, property and deal.

## Update leads and listings

Adds or updates the row, then saves a Gemini reply as a Gmail draft in the same thread.

## Update deals and notify team

Writes only the changed deal step and emails the team a summary.

## Skipped, review and failures

Unclear emails change nothing. Failed sheet writes are caught and logged.

## Log every email

Adds one Email Log row, then moves on to the next email.
